title: MV Music usage from the "dlc" folder?

posts.author: FrozenFacade
posts.body:
Hey all, so I'm finally getting around to trying to properly do the credits for my game and was wondering how using the music in these 2 folders applies. It came with my download of RPG Maker MV so I assume it is good, but do the re-arranged tracks in the RM2K_RearrangeBGM folder require you to own RPG Maker 2000 to use in a game or is it fine to only own MV since this came with my purchase and I see a EULA with the RM2K_RearrangeBGM folder that implies it is fine with only owning MV. The "BaseResource" folder has no EULA so I assume it is just additional MV tracks?
(Just trying to play it safe and double check, since I read you can't use older version music without owning those engines)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
You're fine to use anything that came with your rpg maker download. They are rearrangements. If you wanted to use the original 2k music, then you'd need to own 2k.
(But tbh, those old engines go on sale for dirt cheap all the time for like 2 bucks or whatever, so I'd recommend grabbing them all anyway for the assets.)
